content.short: Bidali lets users buy gift cards from thousands of brands worldwide using crypto.
content.description: Bidali converts crypto into gift cards for a large catalogue of retailers, which remains one of the more practical ways to spend on-chain balances without an offramp or a bank. It sidesteps the licensing burden that direct fiat conversion carries, which is much of why the model persists.
content.meta: Convert crypto into gift cards for thousands of retailers without touching an offramp.
